abstract: We present a unified implementation of three canonical Aether-Index problems---Word Search, Trie construction, and palindromic substring enumeration---within a single Axiom-Interpreter module. The design emphasizes strict height-balance and key-ordering invariants for the Trie, depth-first search with backtracking for the board traversal, and center-expansion for palindrome detection. Formal analysis establishes that all search and insertion operations satisfy $O(\log N)$ bounds, while palindrome enumeration remains $O(n^2)$ in the worst case. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a structural complexity of 143 SLOC and 21 function blocks, with contiguous node layout ensuring spatial locality. No empirical runtime measurements are reported; the study relies on theoretical proofs and static analysis. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Axiom-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261105_010229_5_leetcode_problems__word_sear}
